\newcommand{\libraryfindings}{CapyMOA is faster in 9 of 16 pairs. Its largest speedup is 4.5\ensuremath{\times} for ARF on SEA shift. Its largest accuracy gain is +0.18 pp (GaussianNB, Breast Cancer), and its largest loss is -10.68 pp (Logistic, SEA shift).}

\newcommand{\librarymemory}{Sampled process peak RSS was 168--179 MiB across River's classification runs and 317--401 MiB for CapyMOA.}
